name: 92284 · Yucca Valley, CA
findings: ZIP 92284 (Yucca Valley) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92284 (Yucca Valley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92284 (Yucca Valley) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
